tools.name: check_product
tools.description: Is this product recalled? Give whatever you have: a product name and brand, a UPC/EAN/GTIN barcode, a model number, an NDC drug code or a lot code. Returns matching US recalls (CPSC, FDA, NHTSA) with a confidence level (exact, strong, possible), the reasons for each match and the agency source link,

tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Full-text search across US recalls from CPSC, FDA (food, drugs, devices) and NHTSA, newest and most relevant first. Filter by category and date.
